name: io.github.Mason-Levyy/mfp-mcp
title: MyFitnessPal
description: MCP server for MyFitnessPal: log, search, and analyze your food diary.

environmentVariables.name: MFP_COOKIE
environmentVariables.description: MyFitnessPal session cookie (optional; 'mfp-mcp auth' is the guided alternative)

environmentVariables.name: MFP_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: MyFitnessPal username; only needed if MFP's profile lookup fails for your account

environmentVariables.name: MFP_ALLOW_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to enable diary write tools. Unset, the server is read-only. Do not put the session cookie in this file.

environmentVariables.name: MFP_AUTOREFRESH
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to allow the optional headless-browser session refresh. Off by default.

environmentVariables.name: MFP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Required only for --http. Shared bearer secret of at least 16 characters.
